---
title: "Khuda Hai Hussain Ka Sajjad Ashraf Taqvi Lyrics 2021"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Akbar"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Khuda Hai Hussain Ka Sajjad Ashraf Taqvi.
Jis Ja Hussain Our Khuda Hai Hussain Ka.
Dunya Mein Bas Woh Roza Mila Hai Hussain Ka.
Jaisay Simat Ke Aa Gaye Chodah Ke Chodah Noor.
Roshan Kuch Aisay Khaima Howa Hai Hussain Ka.
Apne Mahawaray Ki Haqeeqat Se Be Khabar.
Soraj Charag Dekh Raha Hai Hussain Ka.
Kabay Ki Chat Pe Nehj-e-Balaga Ke Rang Mein.
Abbas Ne Qaseeda Parha Hai Hussain Ka.
Lakri Ka Jo Assa Tha Woh Mosa Ko De Diya.
Abbas Karbala Mein Assa Hai Hussain Ka.
Kya Khof Ahl-e-Ishq Ko Mehshar Ki Dhop Se.
Parcham Hamarey Sar Pe Khula Hai Hussain Ka.
Iss Rastay Se Aati Hai Khushbo Bahisht Ki.
Kya Matami Guzar Ke Gaya Hai Hussain Ka.
Bas Do Hi Firqay Reh Gaye Hain Karbala Ke Baad.
Ya Hai Koi Yazid Ka Ya Hai Hussain Ka.
Hur Ban Ke Jo Bhi Aaya Galay Se Laga Liya.
Khaliq Ne Dil Hi Aisa Rakha Hai Hussain Ka.
Matam Ke Jo Nishaan Hain Azza Ki Zaban Mein.
Seeno Pe Hum Ne Naam Likha Hai Hussain Ka.
 Akbar Dua-e-Zahra Ka Hai Sara Yeh Asar.
Jo Matami Ko Ishq Mila Hai Hussain Ka.

جس جا حسین اور خدا ہے حسین کا
دنیا میں بس وہ روضہ ملا ہے حسین کا

سینوں پہ ہم نے نام لکھا ہے حسین کا
اکبر دعائے زہرا کا ہے سارا یہ اثر
جو ماتمی کو عشق ملا ہے حسین کا\"\"\"
roman_edits = {
    'Nehj-e-Balaga': 'Nehj-e-Balaga',
    'Ahl-e-Ishq': 'ahl-e-ishq',

proper_names = {'Hussain', 'Khuda', 'Sajjad', 'Ashraf', 'Taqvi', 'Abbas', 'Mosa', 'Karbala', 'Yazid', 'Hur', 'Khaliq', 'Akbar', 'Kabay'}

    ' '.join(
        roman_edits.get(word, word if index == 0 or word in proper_names else word.lower())
        for index, word in enumerate(line.split())
    )
    for line in roman

metadata = metadata.replace(
    'title: \"Khuda Hai Hussain Ka Sajjad Ashraf Taqvi Lyrics 2021\"',
    'title: \"خدا ہے حسین کا\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Khuda Hai Hussain Ka\"',

result = '---' + metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + ''.join('  ' + line + '\\n' for line in roman) + '---\\n\\n' + urdu + '\\n'
assert len(urdu.splitlines()) == len(roman) == 24
assert all(after.casefold() == before.strip().removesuffix('.').casefold()

path.write_text(result)

item.text:
Reconstructed all 23 Urdu verses and verified their line-by-line alignment with the original Roman transcription, now in `romanLyrics`. Updated both titles, set the direction to right-to-left, and removed `noUrdu`.

I kept “Sajjad Ashraf Taqvi” in the opening line because it appears in the supplied transcription and its role there is unclear. Only the selected Markdown file changed.
